title: verify/dkim: DkimResult::Neutral mapped to Fail instead of dedicated variant
description: crates/verify/src/dkim.rs line 93 — DkimResult::Neutral is mapped to VerifResult::Fail. RFC 6376 distinguishes Neutral (signature present but not conclusively verified) from Fail (signature present and definitively wrong). Mapping Neutral to Fail causes callers to treat a transient/neutral DKIM outcome as a definitive signature failure, potentially causing false operator alerts. A dedicated VerifResult::Neutral variant or mapping to NoKey would be more accurate.
